summary: Prices are the 11 Nov closes. US stocks rebounded: the S&P 500 rose 1.3% to 7,619.38, the Nasdaq 1.6% and the Dow 0.5%, with the VIX down 10% to 17.49 and chip names leading (Micron +11.9%, Entegris +11.3%, AMD +7.3%). Asia ran ahead of Wall Street on AI chip demand, with Taiwan's Taiex up 3.6%, Korea's Kospi 2.6% and Japan's Nikkei 1.3%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng fell 1.0% and the Shanghai Composite rose 0.5%; Europe's Stoxx 600 and DAX were up about 0.7% and 1.2% in the latest reports found. Gold closed near 4,000 dollars an ounce, down 0.7%, and the dollar firmed against the euro and Australian dollar. The USDA's November report cut US corn ending stocks to 1,758 million bushels, and EU gas storage stood near 72% full on 9 November. Brent and WTI have no confirmed 11 Nov settlement, so the 10 Nov values are carried.

climate.headline: EU gas storage 72.4% full on 9 November, well below a year earlier
climate.detail: GIE AGSI+ shows storage at 74.6% on 1 November against about 83% on the same date in 2025, and 72.4% on 9 November as drawdowns began. The IEA has said Europe enters winter with its lowest stocks since 2013.
climate.source: Gas Infrastructure Europe (AGSI+), via ENGIE Impact tracker, 11 Nov 2026

climate.headline: COP31: African Group's call for a separate adaptation-finance agenda item does not win consensus
climate.detail: The COP31 president ruled the pledge to triple adaptation finance by 2035 can be discussed under existing items. Reports differ on which African-proposed items were added. A strong El Nino is forecast to bring drier conditions to West Africa.
climate.source: African Group of Negotiators and COP31 presidency, reported by allAfrica, 12 Nov 2026

climate.headline: BoM: strong El Nino expected to peak as a very strong event in November-December
climate.detail: The Bureau's 15 October outlook gives a wetter-than-average chance for much of Australia, but over 80% odds of above-average temperatures across most of the country for November to January.
climate.source: Australian Bureau of Meteorology, climate outlook issued 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: IMD flags a possible new Bay of Bengal system with heavy rain for south India from 14 to 16 November
climate.detail: A low-pressure area may form over the southeast Bay of Bengal around 12-13 November. IMD has not confirmed a cyclone; fishermen are advised to stay out of the Andaman Sea until 16 November.
climate.source: India Meteorological Department, reported by The Week, 12 Nov 2026

climate.headline: PAGASA: at least one more typhoon possible in the Philippines before end-2026 under El Nino
climate.detail: PAGASA has logged 19 tropical cyclones in its area this year. Typhoon Samuel entered and left on 9 November without direct effect; the next name is Tomas.
climate.source: PAGASA, reported by Daily Tribune, 10 Nov 2026
